patterns.en: I've only seen bits of it.

items.ctx: Your friend says she's seen the horror film. You were there: she had her eyes closed half the time.
items.ru: Да ты видела только кусочки — ты же полфильма сидела с закрытыми глазами!
items.en: You've only seen bits of it! You had your eyes closed half the time!
items.why: Some scenes here and there, not the whole film → bits of it.

items.ctx: A friend: “You have to watch The Last Lighthouse! It's slow at first, but it really picks up in episode four.”
items.en: OK, I'll give it a try!
items.why: You'll try it → give it a try.

items.ctx: A friend: “Did you finish the book I lent you?”
items.ru: Честно? Я бросила после пятой главы.
items.en: Honestly? I gave up after chapter five.
items.why: You started it and stopped → gave up after.

items.ctx: You don't like the new café near work: it's expensive. But the coffee there is really good.
items.ru: Там дорого, но кофе отличный, это надо признать.
items.en: It's expensive, but the coffee's great, I'll give it that.
items.why: You admit one good thing → I'll give it that.

items.ctx: A colleague: “Do you like Burnt Toast?” You watched episodes one and two, then stopped.
items.ru: Я бросил после второй серии. Так и не смог втянуться.
items.en: I gave up after episode two. I just couldn't get into it.
items.why: Two whole episodes, then you stopped → gave up after. Bits of it = only some scenes, here and there.

items.ctx: A colleague: “Have you seen Glass Island?” It was on TV at the gym while you were running.
items.ru: Видела только кусочки — в спортзале, на беговой дорожке.
items.en: I've only seen bits of it — at the gym, on the treadmill.
items.why: A few scenes on the gym TV → bits of it.

items.ctx: A colleague: “Come to the new yoga class on Tuesday. It's really fun!”
items.en: Sounds great. I'll give it a try!
items.why: You'll try it → give it a try. Not only for series!

items.ctx: Your friend loved a three-hour film. You found it far too long, but the music was beautiful.
items.ru: Слишком длинный. Но музыка красивая, это надо признать.
items.en: It was far too long. But the music was beautiful, I'll give it that.
items.why: You didn't like it, but you admit one good thing → I'll give it that.

end.q: Two whole episodes, then you stopped: bits of it or gave up after? And the coffee's great: I'll give it that or I'll give it a try?
end.a: Gave up after (bits of it = only some scenes). I'll give it that = I admit one good thing; I'll give it a try = I'll try it.

blocks.instr: How to play: B has a secret card, and A guesses what's on it. Then swap.
how: **B:** draw a secret card on your phone. Don't show it!
**A:** choose a show — from the list or any you know — and ask: Have you seen…? Is it any good?
**B:** answer from your card, in your own words. Don't use the box phrase!
**A:** guess with a phrase from the box: So you've only seen bits of it?
**B:** Exactly! or Not exactly… Then **A** decides: I'll give it a try, or Fair enough, I won't bother. Swap!
